description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application for handling contact form submissions. It exposes an endpoint '/api/contact' that processes contact requests via POST, validates input, and delegates handling to a contact service.

classes.name: ContactController
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing contact form submissions.

methods.name: submitContact
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit contact info, validates input, and invokes the contact service.
